page.overview:
Who is Hanuma?

Hanuma is a monkey who made his debut in Naruto Shippūden: Legends: Akatsuki Rising.

Hanuma has blank white fur and long dark blue spiky hair as a Mohawk going down his back.

Hanuma is able to call in his monkey troops as helping aid against his enemies.

Hanuma made an attempt to get revenge of the endless sets of violence against his species towards the humans, who he thinks as a total threat to his species.
